title: Pickling, fermentation and old recipes
h1: Pickling, fermentation and the limits of old recipes: why a recipe is not a food-safety procedure
dek: From the first American cook book to the home-front canning drive, the printed record shows what people made. It does not show what was safe. What the NCHFP, USDA and CDC say about tested recipes and botulism, with no recipe on this page.
description: A history of pickling and fermenting, and why an old recipe is not a tested procedure: what the NCHFP and CDC say about botulism and tested recipes.
recheck: If the NCHFP, CDC or USDA revise their pickling, fermenting or botulism pages, or when the 1796 printing's text is compared with the 1798 printing we read.
